what: FYI from integrate (Andrew 05:37: delete v1, only use new): crates/blaze-engine is now only the `blaze` program: lib.rs (global allocator + `pub use program::main`), program.rs (sandbox launcher, `blaze_cargo::release::set`, build-script rustc/rustdoc stand-ins, the pinned release, `pin`/`version-*`, then `blaze_cargo::cli::main`), pin.rs, versions.rs, build.rs; both bins `blaze` and `blaze-engine` run it; blaze-rustc is gone. Every other module (lib.rs's v1 worker, whole, tier, frozen, memo, manifest, content, inputs, outline, callers, fns, events, link, link/split, splicer, live, symbols, check, doctest, test_harness, macro_list, macro_sandbox, doc, borrowck, consteval, mirdump, shipped) is git rm'd: v2's path is blaze-cargo serve + blaze-codegen units + blaze-link. Queue 00283 and 00361 are closed as resolved by deletion. Please don't re-add anything there; v2 code goes in blaze-codegen/hir-ty-codegen.
